inference_contract.augmentation: identity only; no D4, random transforms, TTA, crop, threshold or fitted transform
inference_contract.decision_rule: four-class argmax in frozen class order; no calibrated or tuned threshold
inference_contract.determinism: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; deterministic algorithms and cuDNN deterministic; benchmark false; TF32 disabled
inference_contract.input_source: frozen v2H tensors for exactly the common ordered test membership
inference_contract.metadata_controls: load the two hash-verified frozen joblib artifacts; predict with the frozen feature order and train-only preprocessing embedded in those artifacts; do not refit/impute/scale using held-out data
inference_contract.model_mode: eval() and inference_mode/no_grad; float32; no AMP
inference_contract.normalization: exact v2H frozen normalization; no additional family/ImageNet normalization

isolation_and_order: Before test content access, recheck all frozen protocol, selection, checkpoint, code, tensor-manifest, split, membership-byte and label-manifest hashes.
Verify 73 eligible observations and 61 frozen assignment units against the already sealed membership digest; do not include/expose truth to inference workers.
Construct a truth-free ordered membership view for inference. The worker can read only identifiers, unit IDs and tensors; it cannot read the sealed label manifest or class labels.
Run every one of the 38 targets once in the frozen target order, on the same ordered membership, then write and SHA-256 seal all prediction files and their manifest.
After all prediction hashes are immutable, release the frozen truth to a separate scorer exactly once; never expose truth back to prediction workers.
Compute the declared metrics, summaries, bootstrap, randomization and Holm corrections once; do not act on interim scores.

metrics_and_aggregation.empty_or_degenerate_strata: report zero/undefined support explicitly; do not omit or merge bins after viewing results
metrics_and_aggregation.family_summary: for each architecture × representation, report the three seeds and mean ± sample SD (ddof=1); never select best seed
metrics_and_aggregation.metadata: report both fixed metadata/FOV controls separately as descriptive controls; no averaging with neural families
metrics_and_aggregation.metric_conventions: balanced accuracy averages recall over classes with positive true support; macro-F1 includes all four frozen classes with zero when denominator is zero; report degeneracies/support explicitly
metrics_and_aggregation.per_seed: report every network seed separately for each architecture and representation

bootstrap.estimand: seed-level paired metric differences and mean of the three matched-seed differences; conditional on frozen checkpoints
bootstrap.same_draws_across: all paired models, representations, metrics and seeds

paired_statistics.metadata_control_comparisons: paired assignment-unit bootstrap differences versus each A architecture; descriptive only as frozen in v2I

families: 9 hypotheses: three architecture pairs × three primary metrics on A
27 hypotheses: three architecture pairs × three metrics across B/A_outer/B_outer
27 hypotheses for each frozen network control representation versus A, as declared in v2I
multiplicity.intervals: marginal percentile intervals; not simultaneous after Holm

randomization.same_swaps_across: related models, representations, metrics and seeds
randomization.unit: assignment unit; jointly swap model predictions for every object in sampled unit and matched seeds

paired_statistics.unit: 61 frozen v2G assignment units; all objects in a unit stay together

prediction_schema.sealing: SHA-256 each target prediction file and canonical manifest before scorer receives truth

scientific_limits: No test outcome may trigger retraining, replacement, tuning, representation choice, seed selection, threshold changes, or preprocessing changes.
Report all target results, including failures, degeneracies and low-support strata.
Inference uncertainty is conditional on frozen checkpoints; seeds are not an inferential n=3 sample.
The inference/statistical unit is the frozen assignment unit, not each FITS image or treating 73 objects as independent.
No broad astronomical population generalization claim follows from this single frozen held-out collection.
stopping_rules: Any protocol, digest, checkpoint, code, environment, split, membership, tensor-manifest or sealed-label hash mismatch: stop before decoding/inference.
Any missing/extra/duplicate observation, assignment unit, checkpoint, model control, or unequal ordered membership across targets: stop before inference.
Any class-order, tensor shape/range, preprocessing, metadata-feature, deterministic-runtime or truth-isolation mismatch: stop before inference.

Any nonfinite probability, malformed probability row, inference exception, partial prediction, hash mismatch or non-deterministic output: preserve partial evidence and stop; do not retry or repeat a completed target under this plan.

Any metric/scoring discrepancy, support mismatch, confusion-matrix total mismatch, or analysis implementation/hash mismatch: stop scoring and preserve sealed predictions/truth separation; no altered analysis or rerun without separate authorization.
